notes: by all means is the infinitive absolute's own multi-word adverbial rendering under rule 56's one-rendering reading, headed on the content word means; splitting it across the finite verb would leave by and all unowned.
The dative לְ of הָשֵׁב תָּשִׁיבוּ לוֹ אָשָׁם is unrepresented and its suffix takes him (rule 40).
